destination.title: Flux stabilization, tadpole budgets and controlled vacua
destination.question: How do flux choices, charge constraints and stabilization mechanisms determine which compactification vacua can be constructed and controlled?
destination.summary: The numerical selection contains a useful compactification family spanning construction, counting, stabilization costs and physical applications. Its original membership also contains questions with no supplied connection to that core. This revised organizing scope is a proposal, not an accepted interpretation of the numerical region.

systems: Fourfold G-flux systems with M2 tadpoles
Heterotic/type IIB racetrack models as an overlap
targets: Moduli stabilization and its charge cost
Gauge sectors, axion ranges, vacuum stability and control
regimes: Large complex structure and other asymptotic boundaries
Classical supergravity and intrinsically non-geometric settings
assumptions: Flux quantization, source content and charge budgets remain source-specific
Supersymmetric, nonsupersymmetric and conditional constructions remain distinguishable
Conjectures are targets of investigation, not imposed premises
conventions: Distinguish real from complex moduli counts and charge normalizations
Distinguish quadratic masses, higher-order stabilization and complete stabilization
Distinguish sector energies from completed vacuum energies
includes: Ordinary and pre-Swampland construction and counting questions
Methods and settings that contribute without themselves establishing a vacuum
excludes: Relativistic magnetohydrodynamics as a compactification question
Standalone modular-action and worldsheet RG questions without a supplied flux-stabilization connection
String-gas stabilization from the quantized-flux core; retain as an alternate mechanism

sources.title: Supersymmetric SU(5) GUT with stabilized moduli

evidence.text: How do fixed magnetic fluxes on the specified D9-brane stacks constrain complex-structure and Kähler-class parameters? The supplied appendices give explicit flux assignments and solve selected supersymmetry constraints in a three-complex-coordinate construction.

sources.title: Finding all flux vacua in an explicit example

evidence.text: How can supersymmetric flux solutions be enumerated at bounded D3 tadpole in an explicit Calabi–Yau example, and what do the resulting distributions imply for flux tuning and conditional Kähler-uplifted de Sitter constructions?

sources.title: Large Field Inflation/Quintessence and the Refined Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Can integer fluxes stabilize closed-string moduli while leaving a D7 deformation axion parametrically light enough to roll over a large canonical distance?

sources.title: Weakly Coupled de Sitter Vacua with Fluxes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which flux integers may grow while localized tadpole charge stays fixed? The paper singles out fluxes absent from a relevant wedge-product tadpole, rather than asserting that all fluxes can be made large.

sources.title: Type IIB flux vacua and tadpole cancellation

evidence.text: How does flux-induced moduli stabilization interact with tadpole cancellation, and how do the abundance, distribution and perturbative reliability of type-IIB flux solutions depend on their flux tadpole contributions?

sources.title: $G_{4}$ flux, algebraic cycles and complex structure moduli stabilization

evidence.text: Can a properly quantized, primitive G4 flux stabilize all complex structure moduli at a chosen Hodge locus while satisfying M2-tadpole cancellation? Can symmetry simplify F-term equations without leaving unstabilized directions?

sources.title: Sharpening the boundaries between flux landscape and swampland by tadpole charge

evidence.text: How can the flux tadpole charge be evaluated after imposing supersymmetry in the complex field S and complex-structure sectors? This window supplies local algebraic relations, while the underlying compactification and normalization conventions remain outside the packet.

sources.title: Sharpening the boundaries between flux landscape and swampland by tadpole charge

evidence.text: How does flux-induced D3-brane tadpole charge constrain vacuum energy and perturbative stability on a mirror of rigid Calabi–Yau geometry, and what does this imply for the dS, AdS/moduli scale separation, and AdS distance conjectures?

sources.title: F-theory flux vacua at large complex structure

evidence.text: How do four-form fluxes and mirror topological data determine complex-structure stabilization and allowed saxion vevs in F-theory at large complex structure, subject to a finite D3-brane tadpole?

sources.title: The tadpole conjecture at large complex-structure

evidence.text: Does the flux charge required to stabilize complex-structure moduli and the axio-dilaton grow rapidly enough at large complex structure and large h^{2,1} to support the tadpole conjecture?

sources.title: Large complex structure flux vacua of IIB and the Tadpole Conjecture

evidence.text: Does the apparent IIB2 counterexample to the Tadpole Conjecture survive when its polynomially corrected stabilization conditions are combined with statistical estimates for large complex-structure moduli spaces?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in asymptotic flux compactifications

evidence.text: Can asymptotic Hodge theory organize complex-structure flux stabilization near arbitrary moduli-space boundaries into tractable algebraic steps, and clarify the accuracy, flat directions and tadpole costs of the resulting vacua?

sources.title: D7 moduli stabilization: the tadpole menace

evidence.text: Can D7 worldvolume flux stabilize all D7 deformation moduli without exceeding the D3 tadpole budget, when the F-theory base is any smooth weak Fano three-fold and the flux curve has arbitrary genus?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in type IIB orientifolds at h$^{2,1}$ = 50

evidence.text: For a concrete type IIB model with 50 complex-structure moduli, how small can the flux-induced D3 charge be while stabilizing the axio-dilaton and all complex-structure moduli, subject to lower bounds on large-complex-structure and weak-coupling control?

sources.title: Fluxes, vacua, and tadpoles meet Landau-Ginzburg and Fermat

evidence.text: How does the flux D3-tadpole cost constrain masses and higher-order stabilization of moduli in the interior of moduli space, and can non-geometric models support infinite supersymmetric Minkowski and AdS families?

sources.title: The tadpole conjecture in the interior of moduli space

evidence.text: Does the tadpole cost of stabilizing many complex-structure moduli remain proportional to the number stabilized at smooth, discrete-symmetry loci in the interior of moduli space, especially for invariant flux with nonzero on-shell superpotential?

sources.title: Tadpoles and gauge symmetries

evidence.text: How does flux-induced tadpole charge constrain residual non-Abelian gauge symmetry in the selected F-theory K3 × K3 vacua with fully stabilised complex structure, and what minimum charge permits a rootless frame lattice?

sources.title: New non-supersymmetric flux vacua in string theory

evidence.text: Can discrete fluxes below Calabi-Yau orientifold tadpole bounds produce large ensembles of non-F-flat local minima, including hierarchically small positive sector energies useful for future uplifting, and how do their sampled distributions differ from F-flat solutions?

sources.title: More on G-flux and general hodge cycles on the Fermat sextic

evidence.text: Can appropriately quantized primitive G-flux stabilize all complex-structure moduli of the Fermat sextic while respecting the M2 tadpole bound, and how does the required flux norm depend on the stabilization rank?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilization and Stability in Type II/F-theory fux compactifcations

evidence.text: How can flux potentials organize moduli stabilization and vacuum stability in type II/F-theory, and what constraints follow from tadpoles, scale separation and Swampland conjectures?

sources.title: Exact flux vacua, symmetries, and the structure of the landscape

evidence.text: How do symmetries, algebraic reductions of generically transcendental periods, and the distribution of exact W = ∂I W = 0 flux vacua constrain one another, particularly without a tadpole bound?

sources.title: Stabilizing massless fields with fluxes in Landau-Ginzburg models

evidence.text: Can higher-order flux-superpotential terms stabilize fields that remain massless at quadratic order in the 1^9 Landau–Ginzburg model, and how does this distinction affect tadpole bounds? A parallel aim is completing the classification of fluxes with minimal tadpole contribution.

sources.title: Stabilization of a twisted modulus on a mirror of rigid Calabi-Yau manifold

evidence.text: Can three-form fluxes stabilize a twisted modulus together with untwisted moduli and the axio-dilaton on a non-geometric mirror of a rigid Calabi–Yau, while respecting the tadpole bound and proposed swampland constraints?

sources.title: Fully stabilized Minkowski vacua in the 2$^{6}$ Landau-Ginzburg model

evidence.text: Can quantized fluxes in the 2^6 Landau–Ginzburg orientifold stabilize all moduli in supersymmetric Minkowski vacua, including fields with zero quadratic mass, while satisfying tadpole cancellation?

sources.title: Hodge theory and $G_4$ fluxes in weighted projective spaces: Galois action

evidence.text: How do weighted Fermat geometry and Galois action change the integral lattice and tadpole cost of symmetric general Hodge cycles, and can the computed cycles support supersymmetric Minkowski flux vacua?

sources.title: Flux compactifications on Calabi-Yau threefolds

evidence.text: Can quantized three-form fluxes on Calabi–Yau orientifolds with full SU(3) holonomy yield explicit supersymmetric vacua and nonsupersymmetric no-scale vacua with relatively small W using only a few fluxes?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization with open and closed string fluxes

evidence.text: Can constant magnetic fluxes on wrapped D9 branes, combined with closed-string three-form fluxes, stabilize all closed-string moduli in supersymmetric T^6/Z2 orientifolds while satisfying tadpole and world-volume consistency conditions?

sources.title: Magnetic fluxes and moduli stabilization

evidence.text: Can internal magnetic fluxes, charged scalar VEVs and closed-string three-form fluxes consistently stabilize toroidal closed-string moduli while preserving four-dimensional N=1 supersymmetry and cancelling tadpoles?

sources.title: Comments on Brane Recombination, Finite Flux Vacua, and the Swampland

evidence.text: This orientifold patch provides a concrete setting in which negative orientifold charge, magnetized brane charge and positive flux charge must balance. Its explicit brane families make the assumptions behind finite-vacua counting accessible to scrutiny.

sources.title: Supersymmetric SU(5) GUT with stabilized moduli

evidence.text: At fixed discrete flux data, solve holomorphicity for complex structure and zero-FI calibration for Kähler geometry. Positivity selects the physical branch. Charged scalar contributions require a different calibration equation and cannot be omitted from stacks that rely on Higgsing.

sources.title: Finding all flux vacua in an explicit example

evidence.text: Numerical polynomial homotopy continuation tracks paths from a solvable start system to all isolated polynomial roots. Bertini and Paramotopy implement generic-parameter start solutions and parameter homotopies across flux choices.

sources.title: Large Field Inflation/Quintessence and the Refined Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Evaluate retained masses and omitted-state thresholds along the whole cosmological path. Reject a truncation when a supposedly integrated-out tower falls below retained moduli or when non-inflaton fields become cosmologically light.

sources.title: Weakly Coupled de Sitter Vacua with Fluxes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Map a classical stationary potential through its coefficient-and-field rescaling, then test whether flux and orientifold data realize the mapped coefficients. The formal mapping preserves a minimum only when it applies to the full field-dependent potential.

sources.title: Type IIB flux vacua and tadpole cancellation

evidence.text: Use the flux superpotential, Kähler potential, F-term equations and flux Bianchi identities. For geometric setting II, the reviewed finiteness argument factors two real cubics through a common quadratic and uses modular identifications to bound inequivalent integer data.

sources.title: Comments on Brane Recombination, Finite Flux Vacua, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Solve abelian D-flatness by first overshooting in negative charge directions and then correcting each component independently. The operation applies to the specified fixed charge spectrum and unbounded formal field space; it does not establish EFT validity, F-flatness or stable bound-state existence.

sources.title: Large Field Ranges from Aligned and Misaligned Winding

evidence.text: Can winding in an explicit IIA flux model produce a controlled super-Planckian range? The example supplies saxion-flux relations but assumes smeared orientifold sources and the presence of relevant instantons.

sources.title: Small Flux Superpotentials for Type IIB Flux Vacua Close to a Conifold

evidence.text: Can the DKMM construction of exponentially small flux superpotentials be extended to a conifold region, with other complex-structure moduli remaining near large complex structure, and can the required periods be computed analytically?

sources.title: On D-brane moduli stabilisation

evidence.text: Does counting supersymmetric D-brane deformations in a frozen bulk overcount open-string moduli once bulk fields, D-brane backreaction and compact-space RR flux quantization are included?

sources.title: Moduli potentials in string compactifications with fluxes: Mapping the discretuum

evidence.text: Can flux compactifications stabilize all moduli through F-terms while producing broken supersymmetry, a small nonnegative cosmological constant, and a hierarchy within weak coupling and large volume? Are the resulting vacua cosmologically viable?

sources.title: Vacua with Small Flux Superpotential

evidence.text: Can explicit, integrally quantized type IIB flux choices realize exponentially small flux superpotentials at weak coupling and large complex structure, providing the small-W0 ingredient used in KKLT constructions?

sources.title: Algorithmically Solving the Tadpole Problem

evidence.text: How small can flux-induced tadpole charge be while stabilizing every flux-stabilizable modulus away from singularities, and can differential evolution plus local search find the relevant minima for K3×K3 and related indefinite lattices?

sources.title: Runaway in the Landscape

evidence.text: This construction removes Kähler moduli so that a type IIB flux superpotential can involve every surviving geometric modulus and the axio-dilaton. It supplies a setting in which flux stabilization can be studied without adding the usual Kähler-modulus superpotential terms.

sources.title: Fixing D7 Brane Positions by F-Theory Fluxes

evidence.text: How can integral, F-theory-compatible fluxes stabilize D7-brane positions and specified gauge-enhancement singularities, and what conditions determine Minkowski minima, residual moduli and supersymmetry?

sources.title: Type IIA moduli stabilization

evidence.text: Can classical type IIA flux compactifications stabilize all geometric moduli, and admit explicit families with parametrically large volume, weak coupling and a valid four-dimensional description?

sources.title: Flux vacua in type IIB compactifications on orbifolds: their finiteness and minimal string coupling

evidence.text: How many inequivalent flux vacua occur at fixed D3 flux charge, what is their smallest string coupling, and can tadpole cancellation accommodate these vacua in the studied toroidal orientifolds?

sources.title: The tadpole problem

evidence.text: How does the positive D3 charge required for flux stabilization grow with the number of moduli, and can stabilization remain compatible with the negative charge available from tadpole cancellation?

sources.title: Conifold Vacua with Small Flux Superpotential

evidence.text: Can quantized fluxes simultaneously produce an exponentially small classical flux superpotential and stabilize a complex structure modulus exponentially near a conifold, despite the generally order-one holomorphic contribution from conifold flux?

sources.title: Mass spectrum of type IIB flux compactifications — comments on AdS vacua and conformal dimensions

evidence.text: Which features of type II flux compactifications produce integer scalar-operator conformal dimensions, and do perturbative corrections or more general fluxes spoil them? Independently, what constraints do asymptotic moduli stabilization and tadpole charge impose on the heaviest moduli?

sources.title: Critical points and supersymmetric vacua. III. String/M models

evidence.text: For fixed Calabi–Yau X, count inequivalent supersymmetric flux vacua satisfying the tadpole constraint, determine their distribution in moduli space, and estimate the counting error as L→∞.

sources.title: The desert and the swampland

evidence.text: Are points with the largest protected spectral gap also favorable for minimizing the flux charge needed for stabilization? The source proposes this as a question motivated by boundary behavior, without proving that the two optimizers coincide.

sources.title: Supersymmetric Protection and the Swampland

evidence.text: Do the claimed E8 theta-function Minkowski solutions survive the superpotential's dependence on tadpole-required D3 moduli?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization from fluxes in a simple IIB orientifold

evidence.text: Can quantized RR and NS three-form flux replace D3-brane tadpole charge and produce calculable supersymmetric vacua with substantially fewer unfixed moduli?

sources.title: On finiteness of Type IIB compactifications: Magnetized branes on elliptic Calabi-Yau threefolds

evidence.text: Do Ramond–Ramond tadpole cancellation and necessary N=1 supersymmetry conditions bound magnetized D9/D5 configurations uniformly over large-volume Kähler moduli, with explicitly computable topological bounds?

sources.title: The Statistics of supersymmetric D-brane models

evidence.text: How can classically distinct supersymmetric D-brane tadpole solutions be counted efficiently, and what distributions and correlations follow for gauge rank, gauge factors, and chirality, including a rough weighting by flux-vacuum degeneracy?

sources.title: Symmetric fluxes and small tadpoles

evidence.text: Can symmetric flux choices make many-field type IIB vacuum equations tractable while stabilizing many real moduli with small D3 tadpole, and how close do controlled large-complex-structure examples approach the refined Tadpole Conjecture?

sources.title: Comments on classical AdS flux vacua with scale separation

evidence.text: Can one increase flux to improve coupling, volume and scale separation without increasing the compactification's fixed orientifold tadpoles?

sources.title: Tadpole conjecture in non-geometric backgrounds

evidence.text: Does the number of flux-stabilized moduli obey a linear tadpole-charge bound in the deep interior of a non-geometric moduli space, what coefficient is supported, and can supersymmetric Minkowski solutions have every modulus massive within the tadpole budget?

sources.title: The tadpole conjecture in asymptotic limits

evidence.text: Does stabilizing many complex-structure moduli near degeneration boundaries require flux-induced tadpole charge growing linearly with their number, and can asymptotic Hodge theory explain the refined conjecture's slope?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization with non-Abelian fluxes

evidence.text: Which complex-structure and Kähler moduli can constant non-Abelian world-volume magnetic fluxes stabilize on wrapped D9-branes, subject to supersymmetry, flux quantization and RR tadpole constraints?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in asymptotic flux compactifications

evidence.text: Can fluxes stabilize every field in a high-dimensional moduli space while respecting the available tadpole charge? The source presents this as the question addressed by the tadpole conjecture.

sources.title: Supersymmetric SU(5) GUT with stabilized moduli

evidence.text: Can flux stabilization of toroidal geometry coexist with three chiral SU(5) families, RR charge cancellation, and unbroken supersymmetry? The model requires additional stabilizing branes to avoid extra net SU(5)-charged chirality.

sources.title: Modeling General Asymptotic Calabi–Yau Periods

evidence.text: Can exponentially small conifold superpotential terms contribute to the leading scalar potential?

sources.title: A Note on the Magnitude of the Flux Superpotential

evidence.text: Do effective-field-theory consistency, phenomenology or vacuum statistics require a hierarchically small type IIB flux superpotential, or can generic W0 of order 1–10 remain consistent after moduli stabilization?

sources.title: AI usage in string theory, a case study: String Vacua in the Interior of Moduli Space

evidence.text: Can three-form fluxes produce isolated supersymmetric four-dimensional Minkowski vacua deep inside moduli space, including stabilization beyond quadratic masses, and what do these examples imply for tadpole and massless Minkowski conjectures?

destination.title: Consistency constraints from gravitational scattering
destination.question: What can gravitational scattering establish about effective interactions and ultraviolet spectra, and how do infrared treatments, high-energy assumptions and calculational control limit those conclusions?
destination.summary: This is a proposed scientific organization of the numerical neighborhood. Its core includes dispersive consistency, quantitative EFT bounds, weak-gravity tests, ultraviolet spectra and loop corrections. Ordinary amplitude calculations and phenomenology provide adjacent routes; geometric conjectures and nonlocal model calculations retain alternate homes.

systems: Gravitational EFTs with scalar, photon, graviton or charged external states
Ghost-free massive gravity and related scalar theories
Matter sectors coupled to gravity, including Standard Model and symmetry-carrying states
targets: Conditional bounds on interactions, cutoffs and spectra
Validity and infrared finiteness of gravitational dispersion relations
Relations among positivity, running, weak gravity and ultraviolet behavior
regimes: Source-specific dimensions, perturbative orders and coupling limits
Massive and massless theories, without identifying their infrared problems
assumptions: Analyticity, crossing, unitarity, Regge behavior and spectral positivity are tracked separately where supplied
Pole removal alone does not establish a valid positive dispersion relation
Numerical extrema and announced results are not certified completions or universal theorems
conventions: Preserve each source's normalization, sector choice, regulator and version
A source setting or method is not automatically an independent physical question
includes: Ordinary and pre-Swampland EFT work when relevant
Tests of the premises behind claimed consistency bounds
Explicit comparison and application routes to neighboring subjects
excludes: Automatic acceptance of every numerical member as a dispersive-positivity question
Automatic equivalence of distinct infrared prescriptions or ultraviolet assumptions
Treating historical claims, conjectural criteria or numerical patterns as established premises

sources.title: Beyond Positivity Bounds and the Fate of Massive Gravity

evidence.text: Can calculable low-energy contributions to dispersive integrals strengthen positivity into quantitative bounds on EFT couplings and cutoffs, and what do these imply for weakly broken Galileons and ghost-free massive gravity?

sources.title: Unitarity bounds on charged/neutral state mass ratios

evidence.text: At what energy must the Standard Model coupled to gravity acquire a UV completion if forward photon scattering obeys gravitational positivity? The source compares the full Standard Model with an electroweak truncation that excludes QCD.

sources.title: IR side of positivity bounds

evidence.text: How do calculable infrared one-loop effects modify EFT positivity bounds, particularly the two-sided bound on the Galileon-to-Goldstone coefficient ratio, and which analyticity assumptions preserve useful bounds in the massless limit?

sources.title: Causality constraints on nonlinear supersymmetry

evidence.text: How do longitudinal-gravitino subluminality conditions relate to positivity bounds in low-energy goldstino theories, and can alternative constrained-superfield constructions retain minimal spectra while making these causality conditions automatic?

sources.title: Finite energy sum rules for gravitational Regge amplitudes

evidence.text: Can finite-energy information constrain the residue and trajectory of gravitational Regge amplitudes sufficiently to obtain infrared-finite positivity bounds in four dimensions, without requiring control of super-Planckian physics?

sources.title: On (scalar QED) gravitational positivity bounds

evidence.text: How should gravitational positivity bounds account for finite contributions from Regge states after cancellation of the graviton forward pole, especially at one loop? sources.title: String loops and gravitational positivity bounds: imprint of light particles at high energies

evidence.text: Can light-particle loops produce inverse-mass-enhanced corrections to gravitational Regge residues or trajectories at high energy and small momentum transfer, thereby accounting for negative low-energy EFT contributions in gravitational positivity sum rules?

sources.title: Beyond Positivity Bounds and the Fate of Massive Gravity

evidence.text: Defines an IR contour quantity ΣIR from the forward amplitude divided by (s−μ²)^3, including light poles and the subtraction point. Cauchy deformation, crossing, real analyticity, the asymptotic bound, and the optical theorem express it as a positive dispersive integral.

sources.title: Unitarity bounds on charged/neutral state mass ratios

evidence.text: The authors construct one-loop amplitudes from unitarity cuts of tree amplitudes, extracting massive triangle and bubble coefficients with triple and double cuts. A large-mass expansion supplies the coefficients of even powers of s. Tadpoles and specified nonlocal massless-bubble contributions are omitted for the stated EFT purpose.

sources.title: Positivity of Amplitudes, Weak Gravity Conjecture, and Modified Gravity

evidence.text: Compactify one spatial direction on a circle of length L, retaining noncompact 3D Lorentz invariance. Scatter the photon and scalar descending from the 4D photon, retain dilaton, graviphoton and KK contributions, and take L → ∞ after separating divergent terms.

sources.title: Masses and electric charges: gauge anomalies and anomalous thresholds

evidence.text: Uses Landau singularities, on-shell triangle kinematics, Cutkosky discontinuities and dispersion relations to connect anomalous thresholds with triangle anomalies. The anomalous threshold puts all three internal lines on shell, unlike a reduced normal-threshold graph.

sources.title: Gravitational positivity bounds

evidence.text: Split the dispersive integral at a high matching scale M*. Evaluate its Regge tail at fixed negative t, cancel its 1/t divergence against graviton exchange, and retain finite terms involving the residue function f and trajectory derivatives j′ and j″.

sources.title: Sharp boundaries for the swampland

evidence.text: Choose smearing functions, require positivity for all m ≥ M and even J, and optimize a normalized coupling coefficient. Large-mass scaling enforces Fourier positivity, while finite-mass tests supply independent restrictions.

sources.title: Quantum gravity, effective fields and string theory

evidence.text: What leading long-distance quantum corrections follow from gravitational EFT? How far can tree-level KLT relations constrain higher-derivative gauge/gravity actions, and which diagrams dominate a large-D gravitational expansion?

sources.title: Adding subtractions: comparing the impact of different Regge behaviors

evidence.text: How do stronger Regge assumptions, fewer dispersion-relation subtractions, and suppression of charge-two exchange change complex-scalar EFT bounds, with photons, gravity, both, or neither?

sources.title: Graviton-Mediated Scattering Amplitudes from the Quantum Effective Action

evidence.text: How can quantum-effective-action form factors parameterize graviton-mediated scalar scattering, and which restrictions on propagators, vertices, and contact interactions yield acceptable high-energy behavior, pole structure, and stated unitarity/causality properties?

sources.title: Infrared-Finite Positivity Bounds in 4D Gravity

evidence.text: Can a scattering problem with geometric infrared control yield finite gravitational positivity bounds on local four-scalar Wilson coefficients while controlling both low-energy exchange and the full UV absorptive spectrum?

sources.title: Sharp boundaries for the swampland

evidence.text: Can general S-matrix conditions delimit gravitational effective theories quantitatively, including the order-one coefficients multiplying inverse powers of a heavy-state cutoff? sources.title: Positivity with long-range interactions

evidence.text: Can infrared-safe dispersive positivity bounds survive electromagnetic and gravitational long-range forces in four dimensions, with constraints continuously approaching the short-range limit?

sources.title: Gravitational positivity for phenomenologists: Dark gauge boson in the swampland

evidence.text: What conditional restrictions on massive dark U(1) gauge bosons follow from gravitational positivity, and how can phenomenologists calculate them while tracking assumptions about high-energy gravity?

sources.title: Gravity-induced photon interactions and infrared consistency in any dimensions

evidence.text: How do charged-particle loops generate four-photon interactions in gravitational EFTs across spacetime dimensions, and when do photon positivity or extremal-black-hole decay conditions imply WGC-like particle bounds?

sources.title: Positive Signs in Massive Gravity

evidence.text: What restrictions do unitary, analytic graviton scattering amplitudes impose on ghost-free massive gravity, and can the full massive-spin-2 theory avoid the forward-positivity obstruction of its isolated Galileon limit?

sources.title: Is the Standard Model in the Swampland? Consistency Requirements from Gravitational Scattering

evidence.text: Why can nonperturbative QCD affect photon scattering even at very high collision energy? The forward limit keeps momentum transfer soft, allowing hadronic t-channel dynamics to contribute to the absorptive amplitude.

sources.title: Negative running of gravitational positivity

evidence.text: Can massless nonminimal interactions drive the leading scalar, photon and graviton EFT coefficients downward toward the infrared, and can gravitational dispersion relations accommodate that running consistently with UV positivity?

sources.title: RG of GR from on-shell amplitudes

evidence.text: How can on-shell amplitudes organize gravitational EFT renormalization, identify nonrenormalization rules, and compute one-loop gravitational divergences and running of operators containing gravitons?

sources.title: Half-Completeness from Standard Gravitational Dispersion Relations

evidence.text: How much representation completeness follows from gravitational four-point scattering with standard twice-subtracted dispersion relations, positive residues and crossing, without an improved crossing-odd high-energy bound or an assumed spectrum?

sources.title: Completeness from gravitational scattering

evidence.text: Can consistency of gravitational scattering force a finite seed spectrum with nonabelian symmetry to expand into single-particle states carrying every allowed Cartan charge?

sources.title: Is the Standard Model in the Swampland? Consistency Requirements from Gravitational Scattering

evidence.text: At what energy must the Standard Model coupled to General Relativity acquire additional physics if gravitational scattering admits a weakly coupled, analytic, unitary Regge completion?

sources.title: Infrared Consistency and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Does violating the WGC, expressed as z=q/m≥1 in the paper's units, produce an infrared pathology detectable in photon–graviton effective field theory below charged-particle thresholds?

sources.title: Bounding violations of the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Do dispersive constraints on photon scattering imply the black hole WGC once graviton exchange is retained, and how large a violation remains unexcluded under the paper's assumptions?

sources.title: Positivity Bounds and the Massless Spin-2 Pole

evidence.text: Can compactification to three dimensions justify positivity bounds on amplitudes after removing a massless graviton t-channel pole? The authors test this prescription against calculable heavy-field loop matching and examine the assumptions behind three-dimensional gravitational dispersion relations.

sources.title: Is the Standard Model in the Swampland? Consistency Requirements from Gravitational Scattering

evidence.text: Can the crossing-symmetric photon scattering amplitude of the Standard Model coupled to gravity satisfy the dispersive conditions required by a weakly coupled gravitational UV completion?

evidence.text: How tightly do perturbative unitarity, crossing and dispersive constraints restrict leading four-dimensional gravitational EFT corrections? Can low-spin dominance explain why explicit theories occupy much smaller coupling regions, and can different helicities constrain the R³ coupling?

sources.title: Mining the Geodesic Equation for Scattering Data

evidence.text: How much conservative two-body scattering data can be extracted algebraically from perturbed test-particle geodesics, including tidal effects and higher derivative corrections, at leading PM order for arbitrary masses and at all PM orders in the test-particle limit?

sources.title: Non-forward UV/IR relations

evidence.text: Can EFT positivity bounds be extracted entirely away from the forward limit, retaining perturbative control when massless particles generate a Coulomb pole and nonanalytic loop corrections?

sources.title: Ultra-Planckian quark and gluon scattering in agravity

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture From Low Energy Observers' Perspective

evidence.text: To what extent does the WGC constrain a low-energy EFT when its observers can create all subcutoff particles but may lack information about stable charged particles above its cutoff?

sources.title: QED positivity bounds

evidence.text: If strict positivity is imposed after discarding the massless gravitational t-channel pole, what constraints follow for QED coupled to gravity when known charged-particle contributions are removed using improved bounds? Could allowing gravitationally suppressed negativity avoid a low cutoff?

sources.title: Gravity and a universal cutoff for field theory

evidence.text: Can graviton scattering characterize a universal minimum length for local field theory, distinguish it from species counting, and constrain calculable light matter using unitarity and causality?

sources.title: Exploring amplitude criteria for weak gravity in electroweak theory

evidence.text: Can positivity of a forward, graviton-pole-subtracted amplitude quantity provide a common criterion for weak gravity, including bounds on non-Abelian gauge and Yukawa couplings and a connection to the species bound?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture in the sky: gravitational waves from preheating in Einstein-Maxwell-Scalar EFT

evidence.text: How does the higher-derivative photon–graviton interaction affect graviton bremsstrahlung during perturbative reheating, and can the resulting dark radiation constrain the gravitational EFT cutoff under alternative unitarity and black-hole WGC assumptions?

sources.title: Is the Standard Model in the Swampland? Consistency Requirements from Gravitational Scattering

evidence.text: Can forward light-by-light scattering coupled to gravity satisfy the stated positivity condition up to a proposed cutoff, after including the relevant scattering sectors?

sources.title: Gravitational positivity in electroweak sector

evidence.text: Assuming conventional S-matrix positivity extends to gravity, what constraints do forward Higgs and photon scattering impose on electroweak gauge couplings relative to the EFT cutoff, and do they suggest a magnetic-WGC-like relation?

sources.title: Sharp boundaries for the swampland

evidence.text: How do D = 6 coupling bounds change when the negative-u support of their wavepackets is enlarged? Four finite support ranges are compared with a fixed stated family of improved and Xk functionals.

sources.title: Sampling the Graviton Pole and Deprojecting the Swampland

evidence.text: Can finite-resolution sampling handle the graviton pole while retaining explicit subtraction control, imposing linearized unitarity, and extracting absolute EFT-coupling bounds and extremal spectra?

sources.title: The EFT bootstrap at finite M$_{PL}$

evidence.text: How do calculable massless one-loop effects alter gravitational EFT positivity bounds at finite Planck scale, and what conditions keep both the loop expansion and the EFT energy expansion under control?

sources.title: Reverse Bootstrapping: IR Lessons for UV Physics

evidence.text: Can calculable infrared Standard Model photon–graviton scattering constrain ultraviolet gravitational amplitudes through gravitational positivity bounds, thereby reversing their usual interpretation as constraints on EFT coefficients?

sources.title: Unearthing the intersections: positivity bounds, weak gravity conjecture, and asymptotic safety landscapes from photon-graviton flows

evidence.text: Which low-energy photon–graviton EFTs arise from asymptotically safe RG trajectories, and how do their Wilson coefficients compare with scattering positivity, black-hole entropy positivity and a higher-derivative electric WGC condition?

sources.title: Energy correlators in four-dimensional gravity

evidence.text: Which inclusive energy-flow observables are infrared finite in four-dimensional graviton scattering, including endpoint contact terms, and what controls their angular limits and analytic structure?

sources.title: Solar System constraints on light propagation from higher derivative corrections to general relativity and implications for fundamental physics

evidence.text: How does a four-derivative curvature–photon coupling modify solar Shapiro delay, what constraint follows from historical Cassini radio-link data, and how does that constraint relate to a conditional weak-gravity bound on EFT coefficients?

sources.title: Scalar weak gravity bound from full unitarity

evidence.text: Can dispersion relations and bounded four-dimensional partial waves yield an upper bound on gravitational coupling in terms of scalar EFT interactions, despite the forward graviton pole and massless-loop singularities?

sources.title: Sharp boundaries for the swampland

evidence.text: Can a crossing-symmetric scattering solution realize the proposed linear Regge trajectory, with or without the optional constant-mass trajectory? The numerical extremal pattern motivates this existence question but does not answer it.

sources.title: Effective Field Theory islands from perturbative and nonperturbative four-graviton amplitudes

evidence.text: Do the small gravitational EFT islands observed in four-dimensional perturbative models persist for nonperturbative matter and higher-dimensional graviton scattering, suggesting stronger consistency constraints?

sources.title: The Equivalence Principle at High Energies Completes the Spectrum

evidence.text: Does charge-independent leading high-energy gravitational scattering force every irreducible representation generated from a seed charge to occur as a single-particle state, and constrain how those representations contribute to scattering?

evidence.text: The scattering experiment probes contact self-interactions of a massless scalar in the presence of graviton exchange. The heavy threshold M is separated from low-energy dynamics, while all low-energy interactions become small together in a specified weak-coupling family.
